backingType.note: Short-term US Treasuries and bank demand deposits per Ondo / rwa.xyz asset page.

attestationAgeDays.note: PROXY: Ankura Trust (Verification Agent) publishes daily transparency reports; age taken as cadence, not a specific report date.

collateralRatio.note: CONSERVATIVE FLOOR: fully-backed claim per verification reports. Ondo additionally cites a first-loss equity cushion; cushion size not independently sourced this pass, so no over-collateralization credit is taken.

onchainRedemption.note: SECONDARY SOURCE: holders submit USDY, USD wired T+1. New mints face a 40-50 day transfer restriction (mint-side, not redemption-side).

noticeDays.note: SECONDARY SOURCE: T+1 USD wire after redemption submission.

singlePointsOfFailure.note: Ankura Trust as single Verification+Collateral Agent; banking partners holding demand deposits.

attestationCadenceDays.note: Daily transparency reports plus monthly independent review, both via Ankura Trust.

docsCompleteness.note: Checklist: docs site, offering terms, verification-agent reports, risk disclosures present; methodology applied uniformly across assets.
